intro: Shael'dryn is an inquisitive dryad residing beside the Moonwell of Purity, east of Iris Lake in Ashenvale. She serves as a vital contact for night elf scouts investigating forest corruption. She plays a pivotal role in aiding Astranaar's sentinels with cleansing relics to combat demonic and foul influences spreading across the wilderness.

p: Stationed beside the Moonwell of Purity, Shael'dryn keeps watch alongside the night elf sentinels guarding the eastern approaches of the forest. When corruption surfaces among the local wildlife or tainted relics threaten the land's harmony, her deep natural understanding allows her to guide adventurers through the steps required to restore spiritual balance.
